units.source_text: 虽有此好机会，源氏并不谈起夕雾之事。

en.t: Although this was such a good opportunity, Genji did not bring up the matter of Yugiri.

units.source_text: 因为他估计内大臣不会同意，冒昧开口，自讨没趣。

en.t: He judged that the Inner Minister would not agree, and that speaking rashly would only invite embarrassment.

units.source_text: 而在内大臣呢，看见对方绝不谈起，也就不肯自动提出，这件事终于照旧闷在心里。

en.t: As for the Inner Minister, seeing that the other man never mentioned it, he too refused to raise it on his own, and so the matter remained shut up in their hearts as before.

units.source_text: 临别他对源氏说：“今夜本当亲送回府，但突然如此，深恐惹人疑怪，故恕不相送。

en.t: At parting he said to Genji, "Tonight I ought properly to escort you home myself, but since this has happened so suddenly, I fear it would arouse people's suspicion, so please forgive me for not seeing you off.

units.source_text: 今日有劳大驾，改日自当趋前道谢。”

en.t: You have taken the trouble to come today; on another day I shall come to you in person to offer my thanks."

units.source_text: 源氏便和他相约：“尚有一言：太君清恙已大见好转，前日奉恳之事，务请慨允，准时出席。”

en.t: Genji then secured his promise, saying, "One more word: your honored mother's illness has greatly improved, so regarding the request I made the other day, please be generous enough to consent and attend at the appointed time."

units.source_text: 两人面上都带喜色，分别启驾返邸，仆从奔走呼唤，气势十分雄大。

en.t: Both men had joyful expressions as they set out separately for their residences, while their attendants ran about calling to one another in a scene of great magnificence.

units.source_text: 内大臣的随从人等想道：“今日不知有何大事。

en.t: The Inner Minister's attendants thought, "I wonder what important affair there is today.

units.source_text: 两位大臣难得会面，我家大臣面色特别愉快。

en.t: It is rare for the two ministers to meet, and our lord looks especially pleased.

units.source_text: 莫非太政大臣又把什么政权让与他了？”

en.t: Could it be that the Chancellor has again handed over some political authority to him?"

units.source_text: 他们都在瞎猜，谁也想不到玉鬘之事。

en.t: They were all guessing blindly, and no one imagined that it concerned Tamakazura.
